title: Brand Industry Map
description: The canonical brand reference dataset — agency-wide source-of-truth for brand metadata (industry classification, domain, social handles + follower counts, company stage, revenue, headcount, creator-program presence). Lives at `data/brand_industry_map.json` (committed; not gitignored — global reference data, not per-talent). Every brand-related schema in the system references entries here by `brand_id` (kebab-case slug derived from `name`). Refreshed by Phase 2 brand discovery + Phase 3a contact enrichment. Brand handles in `social_handles` are critical input to Phase 4.8 deliverable detection (the cron scores candidate posts on whether the talent tagged the brand via `@{handle}`).

version.description: Schema version of the file shape. Bump on breaking shape changes (additive changes don't require version bump).

updated.description: When this file was last regenerated.

brands.description: Canonical brand records. Sorted by name for deterministic git diffs.

enrichment_field_definitions.description: Optional documentation of what each field means + source authority. Not required for validation.

brand.description: One brand entry. `brand_id` is implicit — derived from `name` via normalisation (lowercase + kebab-case + suffix stripping). All other fields optional; absence = unknown for that brand.

name.description: Display name (e.g. 'Lululemon Athletica'). The normalised slug of this becomes the brand_id used as FK in brand_candidates / brand_contacts / brand_deals / deals / etc.

aliases.description: Alternate names the brand goes by (parent company names, abbreviations, legacy names). Used for fuzzy matching during enrichment + outreach reply classification.

domain.description: Primary web domain (e.g. 'nike.com'). No https://; no path. Used as merge key for Apollo contact lookups + Exa search seeding.

social_followers.description: Brand's own social-media follower counts per platform. Integer counts as of as_of_year. Platforms with minimal/uncertain presence omitted.

social_handles.description: Brand's own social-media handles per platform (NOT contact handles — those live on `brand_contact.social_handles`). Handles WITHOUT the leading `@` symbol (e.g. `nike` not `@nike`). Critical input to Phase 4.8 deliverable detection — cron uses `{platform}_handle` to score whether the talent's candidate post mentions the brand (e.g. searches captions/tags for `@nike`). Refreshed weekly via Exa; on change detected, last_handle_change timestamp logged for audit. Populated as discovered — absent = handle unknown for that platform.

youtube.description: Channel handle (the @-style handle YouTube introduced in 2022, not the legacy channel name).

last_handle_change_at.description: Most recent date any handle here changed (rebrand detection).

legal_entity.description: Brand's legal entity for contracts/invoicing. Often differs from trading name (e.g. brand 'Nike' = legal entity 'Nike, Inc.'). Captured opportunistically — agent may also provide via contract_pack.context_artefacts.brand_legal_info upload. Populating this field once at the brand level avoids per-deal re-capture friction.

legal_name.description: Full legal entity name (e.g. 'Nike, Inc.', 'Lululemon Athletica Inc.', 'GymShark Limited').
